title: Reduced boundary has full measure: differentiation of the normal (Simon Ch. 3, 4.2; Ch. 1, 3.23)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, let D ⊆ ℝ^{m+1} be open, let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^{m+1} with μ(ℝ^{m+1} \ D) = 0 and μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ D, and let ν : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^{m+1} be Borel with |ν(y)| = 1 for every y. Then for μ-a.e. y: y ∈ D and μ(B̄_ρ(y))_ℝ^{-1} ∫_{B̄_ρ(y)} ν dμ → ν(y) as ρ ↓ 0 (μ(·)_ℝ = ENNReal.toReal, 0^{-1} = 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)), IsOpen D → μ Dᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid (m + 1)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → μ K ≠ ∞) → Measurable ν → (∀ y, ‖ν y‖ = 1) → ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, y ∈ D ∧ Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (μ (closedBall y ρ)).toReal⁻¹ • ∫ z in closedBall y ρ, ν z ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (ν y))
